2023-12-24
Claimant reported a left-turn collision at an intersection and described the other vehicle pulling out in front of them.
The claimant has no attorney and is handling the claim personally.
2024-01-27
Scene photos, two independent witness statements, and the other driver's account all match the claimant's
description of how the collision happened. The damage to the claimant's vehicle is consistent with the reported
impact.
2024-02-10
The claimant reports a concussion and has been treated on a routine course that has tapered as symptoms
improved. No earlier injury to the same area of the body is known. It is not yet clear whether this injury came from the
collision.
2024-04-08
Nothing in the file suggests the vehicle damage predates the start of coverage, and no earlier damage to the vehicle
is known. The driver is named on the policy.
2024-05-18
The repsonding officer and two witnesses state that the claimant was not inside the vehicle when the crash occurred,
which conflicts with the acconut given so far. I have requested the officer's full report and the witness contact details
to clarify this point.
2024-06-19
The claimant has repeated the same account in every conversation to date. The open questions remain the cause of
the injury and the discrepancy about the claimant's position in the vehicle, and the file will stay open until both are
resolved.
</page>

List the facts written on this page. Copy each value exactly as it is written: same spelling,
punctuation and date format. Do not add anything that is not on this page. Use "" for a missing value.

Person "role" must be one of: claimant, attorney, defense_attorney, expert, doctor, officer, adjuster, witness, other.
  claimant = the person who made the claim (also called patient, plaintiff, client, customer,
  or the driver who reported it). attorney = a lawyer for the claimant or plaintiff.
  defense_attorney = a lawyer for the insurance company or defendant.
Organization "type" must be one of: repair_shop, clinic, law_firm, court, insurer, police, other.
"policy_numbers" = only values labeled as a policy number. A claim number is not a policy number.
"street" and "city" = the person's own home address, only if the page gives it. Never use the
address of a clinic, shop, firm or court for a person.
"loss_dates" = only a date that the page clearly gives as the date of the accident, crash, loss or
injury. Do not list the date of a note, letter, report, visit, statement, filing or signature.
"words_before" = the words written on the page directly before that date, copied exactly, that say
it is the loss date. Examples: "Date of loss:", "Crash date:", "Date of injury:", "the collision on".
